notes: judgeSeverity is the original cluster severity from the judges; reviewVerdict/reviewSeverity are from the skeptical reviewer; priority is this report’s final P0-P3 (null for dropped/refuted). reproStatus is the independent verifier’s result (yes/partial/not-applicable). Member IDs refer to the raw tester findings F1-F261 in the audit handoff. visualSweepMembers (added 2026-09-25) record findings from the visual-QA sweep: inspectorSeverity is the inspector's, adjustedSeverity the screenshot skeptic's; priorRef maps to docs/qa/2026-09-24/findings.json.

priorAuditTags.still-open: present in the prior register and still observed
priorAuditTags.regressed: introduced or worsened by a prior-audit fix or the drawer rework

findings.title: NPE in Ram.removeComponent during Redo Delete leaves the circuit half-mutated and not dirty
findings.rootCause: Ram.java:395 passes null RamState to closeHexFrame (:162); Circuit.mutatorRemove (917-936) runs the factory hook after comps.remove with no rollback; Project.redoAction never sets dirty
findings.recommendedFix: Null-guard Ram.removeComponent/closeHexFrame; try/catch factory hooks in mutatorRemove; mark dirty or roll back on throw; JUnit regression

findings.title: Unknown or invalid components are dropped at load and silently deleted from disk on the next Save
findings.rootCause: XmlReader.initAttributeSet (182-193) throws on any NumberFormatException; XmlCircuitReader (75-117) skips unknown components; project not dirtied, raw XML not preserved
findings.recommendedFix: Default bad attributes with a warning; keep unknown elements as opaque XML re-emitted by XmlWriter; mark dirty and confirm before overwriting a file that loaded with errors

findings.title: Recovered autosave is not marked dirty; closing without a prompt deletes the recovered edits
findings.rootCause: LogisimFile.java:304 sets autosaveLoaded; isAutosaveLoaded() (:818) has no callers; Frame.dispose -> stopAutosaveThread(true) deletes the autosave
findings.recommendedFix: Mark the project dirty after an autosave load; keep the autosave until explicit Save/Discard; show a recovered banner

findings.title: Redo never updates the file dirty flag; tab dot and title disagree with the real state
findings.rootCause: Project.redoAction (442-468) ++undoMods but never file.setDirty(isFileDirty()); no DIRTY_STATE event; autosave dirty flag never set
findings.recommendedFix: Call file.setDirty after redo; ++undoMods only when isModification(); derive tab dot and title from Project.isFileDirty(); regression tests for the four dirty paths

findings.title: Opening the Timing diagram while the clock is ticking crashes the simulator (NPE, leftPanel null)
findings.rootCause: ChronoPanel constructor calls setModel() -> addModelListener before configure() creates leftPanel/rightPanel; SimThread fires signalsExtended (:274) in that window; SimThread.run catch(Throwable) stops the simulation
findings.recommendedFix: Register the listener after configure(); null-guard; marshal callbacks to the EDT (see C20)

findings.title: Save resets the file mode to 0600, replaces symlinks with regular files, and overwrites read-only files
findings.rootCause: Loader.java:553 Files.createTempFile (0600) then :567-575 Files.move(ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING) onto the path itself
findings.recommendedFix: toRealPath(); Files.isWritable check with Save As offer; copy PosixFilePermissions/owner onto the staged file

findings.title: Save As can target a file already open in another window, which later clobbers the saved work
findings.rootCause: ProjectActions.doSaveAs (:806) checks only exists(); no Projects.findProjectFor unlike doOpen
findings.recommendedFix: Refuse or warn when another open project owns the target file

findings.title: Unsaved SoC assembler source is lost on quit or close; cancelling its save wipes it
findings.rootCause: AssemblerPanel.java:356-372 prompts in windowClosed with Yes/No and clears unconditionally; :223 uses showOpenDialog; doQuit ignores assembler buffers
findings.recommendedFix: windowClosing with Save/Discard/Cancel; include buffers in quit/close checks; showSaveDialog

findings.title: Loading strips labels that equal a component type name, with per-clash info-icon 'Message' modals (also in -tty)
findings.rootCause: Circuit.mutatorAdd -> removeWrongLabels (896, 940-960) runs on the XmlCircuitReader path; case-insensitive; parentless INFO dialog per clash
findings.recommendedFix: Skip removeWrongLabels during load; validate once; rename rather than delete; one warning dialog naming the labels

findings.title: VHDL-invalid labels ('café', 'my out') are rewritten with a random UUID suffix on load
findings.rootCause: XmlReader.ensureLogisimCompatibility (650-657, called :1152) runs for all versions; generateValidVHDLLabel (:739) appends UUID.randomUUID(); tunnels included
findings.recommendedFix: Limit to old file versions; skip Tunnel/Text; deterministic suffix; notify the user

findings.title: Autosave serialises circuits off the EDT without locks; a RuntimeException silently kills autosave for the session
findings.rootCause: AutosaveThread -> XmlWriter iterates live getNonWires() (XmlWriter 280-296) while the EDT mutates; only IOException caught (LogisimFile 93-110); one failure sets run=false
findings.recommendedFix: Snapshot to bytes on the EDT or under locks; catch RuntimeException, report, keep retrying

findings.title: -tty swallows load errors: dropped components give wrong results and exit code 0
findings.rootCause: OptionPane.showOptionDialog (335-346) returns CLOSED_OPTION silently when !Main.hasGui(); Loader.showError goes through it; TtyInterface ignores load messages
findings.recommendedFix: Print messages to stderr when headless; exit non-zero when the load reported errors

findings.title: A self- or mutually-recursive subcircuit file causes StackOverflowError, no window, and a lingering JVM
findings.rootCause: Loader has no subcircuit cycle check; SimulationTreeCircuitNode.<init>/computeChildren (45,110) recurse unbounded
findings.recommendedFix: DFS cycle check after load, reject with a message; make the tree cycle-safe

findings.title: Any placed VHDL entity without QuestaSim stops the whole circuit's simulation; -tty exits 255
findings.rootCause: VhdlEntity.propagate (:251) and VhdlEntityComponent.propagate (:185) set outputs UNKNOWN then throw UnsupportedOperationException; SimThread treats it as fatal
findings.recommendedFix: Return without throwing; show a non-fatal badge; catch in TtyInterface

findings.title: An unconnected ROM crashes HDL generation with a raw NPE that is not logged
findings.rootCause: Hdl.getBusName returns null; RomHdlGeneratorFactory -> WithSelectHdlGenerator -> LineBuffer.applyPairs; reportDownloadFailure logs only toString()
findings.recommendedFix: Null-check bus names; DRC error naming the component; log stack traces

findings.title: Merging a file that uses a built-in library asks to locate a 'library file'; Cancel throws LoaderException
findings.rootCause: LogisimFileActions.MergeFile (139-144) calls getFileFor for every descriptor incl. '#TTL'; doMerge does not catch LoaderException
findings.recommendedFix: Auto-add built-ins; prompt only for file/jar descriptors; catch in doMerge

findings.title: Export Image allocates a full raster even for SVG/TikZ and fails silently on large circuits
findings.rootCause: ExportThread.export (ExportImage 246-251) creates the BufferedImage before the format branch; IAE/OOM outside the try; monitor never closed
findings.recommendedFix: Allocate only for raster formats; bound size; catch and tell the user

findings.title: Closed project windows are never garbage-collected (static LocaleManager listeners)
findings.rootCause: LocaleManager (91-126) static strong listener list; removeLocaleListener never called; Frame/Canvas/Toolbox/AttrTable/LogFrame/HexFrame register
findings.recommendedFix: Unregister in dispose() or hold weakly / tie to displayability

findings.title: A malformed user template is accepted, after which every File > New throws an NPE
findings.rootCause: TemplateOptions (150-158) ignores LogisimFile.load returning null and sets CUSTOM; createNewFile falls back only on IOException
findings.recommendedFix: Commit the template only when it loads; treat null like IOException

findings.title: Log Model and chronogram Swing components are mutated across SimThread and the EDT without synchronisation
findings.rootCause: Model.signals plain ArrayList iterated on SimThread (636-655), edited on the EDT (250-300); ChronoPanel.signalsExtended (273-282) and RightPanel.updateSize (200-217) revalidate on SimThread
findings.recommendedFix: Sample on SimThread into an immutable batch; apply on the EDT with one coalesced invokeLater

findings.title: IndexOutOfBoundsException on a simulation-state switch leaves the timing diagram on the wrong circuit with mislabelled signals
findings.rootCause: RightPanel.updateSelected (299-301) indexes a stale selection against the new model; exception aborts LogFrame.setSimulator/ChronoPanel.modelChanged
findings.recommendedFix: Clear the selection before swapping models; clamp indices

findings.title: The expression parser gives AND and OR the same precedence (a+b*c becomes (a+b)c), contradicting the help page
findings.rootCause: Parser.java 188-196, 344-381: '+' and '*' both LOGIC_PRECEDENCE, '&' BITAND (below '+'), word forms PYTHON_*, '^' OPLUS; ana-expr.html documents NOT > AND > XOR > OR
findings.recommendedFix: One precedence table for all spellings; parser unit tests keyed to the help; update the page

findings.title: Save As rejects hyphens and spaces, even the project's own current filename
findings.rootCause: ProjectActions.java:115 pattern [^a-z\d_.] applied only in Save As
findings.recommendedFix: Drop the restriction or make it a non-blocking HDL warning on every save path

findings.title: A restored bottom drawer up to 720px hides the canvas and forces 20% zoom
findings.rootCause: ShellLayout 62-69: bottomSplit has no editor minimum; bottomHeight clamped only to MAX_PANEL; Frame.java:1067 initial zoom uses the squeezed viewport
findings.recommendedFix: Reserve a minimum editor height; clamp to the window; compute initial zoom after layout

findings.title: --test-vector always exits 0, even when vectors fail or loading fails
findings.rootCause: Startup.java:1070 discards the doTestVector result; :1127 System.exit(0); -w also needs a display
findings.recommendedFix: Exit non-zero on failures or load errors; allow headless

findings.title: A large test-vector file freezes the UI for minutes (a full re-sort queued per result row)
findings.rootCause: gui/test/Model.setResult posts invokeLater(updateSortedIndices) per row; O(N^2 log N) on the EDT
findings.recommendedFix: Coalesce updates on a timer; sort once at the end

findings.title: The hotkey editor enters record mode on focus, blanks fields on Tab, keeps unapplied edits after close, loses focus after Apply
findings.rootCause: JHotkeyInput 59-72: focusGained -> enterEditMode; focusLost -> exitEditModeWithoutRefresh; nothing cancels on hide; Apply moves focus to the filter
findings.recommendedFix: Record only on explicit activation; restore text on blur/hide; return focus after Apply

findings.title: No keyboard placement, selection or nudging on the canvas, and no AccessibleContext
findings.rootCause: AddTool.keyPressed (364-435) has no place action; EditTool (300-307) maps arrows to reface; Canvas has no AccessibleContext
findings.recommendedFix: Enter places at viewport centre; arrows nudge; rotate on R; add AccessibleContext

findings.title: Toolbar tool buttons take focus but show no focus indicator
findings.rootCause: ToolbarButton.java:71 focusable, :90 setFocusPainted(false), paintComponent (156-190) never checks isFocusOwner
findings.recommendedFix: Paint a focus ring like ActivityBar.Item

findings.title: A global Ctrl+Tab dispatcher traps focus in JTables and switches circuits instead
findings.rootCause: EditorTabs.dispatchTabKey (128-145) KeyEventDispatcher consumes every Ctrl+Tab in the root pane
findings.recommendedFix: Use Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown, or skip when the focus owner is a JTable/JTextComponent

findings.title: The 'Color blind colors' preset makes logic-1 wires near-invisible (1.23:1 on light) and is not theme-aware
findings.rootCause: SimOptions.applyColorBlindPalette (142-178) hard-codes one value set into the current theme
findings.recommendedFix: Per-theme CVD-safe palettes with a contrast unit test

findings.title: A width mismatch through same-named tunnels shows consistent badges on each side, with no pointer to the conflict
findings.rootCause: Width badges are per sub-net; tunnels are not badged with the partner width; same-label partners not highlighted
findings.recommendedFix: Badge tunnels with '8!=4'; highlight partner tunnels on select/hover

findings.title: Error states (width banner, E/U wires) are not actionable: no locate, tooltip, legend or help link
findings.rootCause: Canvas.java 313-325 paints the banner as inert text; wires have no ToolTipMaker; no link to the wire-colour help
findings.recommendedFix: Clickable problems chip cycling through errors; wire tooltips; legend with help link

findings.title: No way to export the timing diagram or log values to a file from the docked panel
findings.rootCause: LogFrame.java:356 wires ChronoPanel.getPrintHandler only to its own menubar, hidden in docked mode; FilePanel never instantiated
findings.recommendedFix: Add export and WaveDrom actions to the timing panel toolbar

findings.title: Loading a JAR with no manifest throws an uncaught NPE on the EDT and the user sees nothing
findings.rootCause: ProjectLibraryActions.java:110 and LogisimFileActions.java:281 dereference a null Manifest
findings.recommendedFix: Null-check the manifest so the class-name prompt appears; show an error when the JAR cannot be opened

findings.title: Any exception while creating a window calls System.exit(-1), killing other dirty projects
findings.rootCause: ProjectActions.CreateFrame.run (84-100) catches Exception, shows an error, System.exit(-1)
findings.recommendedFix: Exit only when no other project is open; otherwise dispose the failed frame

findings.title: The Latin-1 fallback for old files uses UTF-8 on JDK 18+, so accented text becomes U+FFFD on save
findings.rootCause: LogisimFile.java:289 new FileReader(file) uses the platform default charset
findings.recommendedFix: Pass StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1

findings.title: Save silently overwrites changes made to the file outside the app
findings.rootCause: Loader.save does not record or check the mtime
findings.recommendedFix: Store mtime at load/save; prompt when it changed

findings.title: The analyzer has no undo: re-analysing or importing silently replaces a hand-made table, and one K-map click changes the table
findings.rootCause: Single reused analyzer model; no confirmation before replacing; no undo stack
findings.recommendedFix: Confirm before replacing a changed model; analyzer undo stack; K-map editing hint

findings.title: TikZ/SVG export stops part-way on an NPE from a null label colour (classic Register, Random, Telnet)
findings.rootCause: Components paint with undeclared LABEL_COLOR (null); TikZInfo.getColorName (:136) dereferences null; export thread does not catch
findings.recommendedFix: setColor(null) no-op; default colour in those painters; catch per circuit and report

findings.title: Deleting timing signals leaves a stale spotlight, causing IndexOutOfBoundsException on mouse move
findings.rootCause: Model.remove (:262) items.contains(spotlight) compares SignalInfo with Signal (@SuppressWarnings unlikely-arg-type)
findings.recommendedFix: Fix the comparison; bounds-check the index

findings.title: Adding a bus variable with range syntax throws IllegalArgumentExceptions in the analyzer
findings.rootCause: VariableTab.ok off by one (w -= 1, :626), combo index unbounded; VariableList.add counts variables not bits
findings.recommendedFix: Validate against the real bit width; show variableMaximumError

findings.title: -tty cannot load any circuit with a SoC bus without a display (HeadlessException)
findings.rootCause: SocBusStateInfo extends JDialog and is built in SocSimulationManager.registerComponent
findings.recommendedFix: Create the dialog lazily or skip when headless

findings.title: Validating an edited VHDL entity does not update placed instances; their ports change only on reload
findings.rootCause: VhdlEntity.contentSet (324-326) only refreshes the icon; updatePorts runs only from appearanceChanged
findings.recommendedFix: Call updatePorts + fireInvalidated on all instances in contentSet

findings.title: Load time grows quadratically with circuit size (WireRepair.doSplits, removeWrongLabels)
findings.rootCause: WireRepair.doSplits checks every wire against every location; Circuit.removeWrongLabels scans all components on each add
findings.recommendedFix: Spatial index in doSplits; skip or index the label check during load

findings.title: A leftover autosave breaks -tty; a corrupt autosave blocks the GUI and blames the real file
findings.rootCause: LogisimFile.load (257-264) returns null on CLOSED_OPTION (headless prompt); no fallback when the autosave fails to parse
findings.recommendedFix: Skip the autosave check when headless; fall back to the original file

findings.title: If the file passed at startup cannot be opened, the app exits after one error
findings.rootCause: Startup.java:1106 System.exit(-1) when numOpened == 0
findings.recommendedFix: Fall back to the welcome screen

findings.title: A missing library prompts twice and reports an 'XML formatting error'; -tty crashes with HeadlessException
findings.rootCause: LogisimFile.load catches LoaderException and retries with the legacy reader; Loader.getFileFor (239-259) opens a chooser even when headless
findings.recommendedFix: Rethrow LoaderException; throw instead of prompting when headless

findings.title: -tty --load discards the whole RAM image on any warning but reports success
findings.rootCause: TtyInterface.loadMemories (239-241) ignores HexFile.open returning false
findings.recommendedFix: Check the return value and fail, or load the valid prefix with a warning

findings.title: -tty keyboard stdin: a flood causes OOM, and EOF makes the reader thread spin at 100% CPU
findings.rootCause: StdinThread.run (598-613) loops on read()==-1 and fills an unbounded queue
findings.recommendedFix: Stop on EOF; bounded queue with back-pressure

findings.title: -tty halt with no halt pin runs forever silently
findings.rootCause: runSimulation while(true) with no missing-halt-pin check and no tick cap
findings.recommendedFix: Error when haltPin is null; add --max-ticks

findings.title: The -tty truth table wraps at 31+ input bits (1<<n overflow), giving wrong output and exit 0
findings.rootCause: TtyInterface.java:440 rowCount = 1 << inputCount; TruthTable.isInputSet overflows the same way
findings.recommendedFix: Reject inputs above a cap; exit non-zero

findings.title: Pin 'Label Location' is shown and saved but ignored when drawing
findings.rootCause: Pin.java 753-767, 823-838 always use pinLabelLoc(facing); LABEL_LOC ignored though an Alt+arrow configurator is installed (:748)
findings.recommendedFix: Honour LABEL_LOC or hide the attribute for pins

findings.title: Welcome 'New project' opens a second window and leaves the blank Untitled window behind
findings.rootCause: Frame.java:303-307 calls doNew while Open uses doOpenReplacingBlank; ProjectActions 193-201 always creates a frame
findings.recommendedFix: Reuse the blank project

findings.title: The welcome screen's recent list is not refreshed after a save in an already-showing welcome panel
findings.rootCause: WelcomePanel has no RECENT_PROJECTS listener; refresh only runs when the panel is shown
findings.recommendedFix: Listen to the preference or refresh on window activation

findings.title: Ctrl+W closes only the editor tab and the toolbar layout collapses when the palette hides
findings.rootCause: EditorTabs.java:107 binds Ctrl+W to tab close; toolbar layout depends on palette visibility
findings.recommendedFix: Keep the toolbar layout stable; consider offering to close the project

findings.title: The Properties header shows the last layout selection while editing the appearance
findings.rootCause: Frame.java:1150-1152 updates inspector.setTitle only on setAttrTableModel, not on appearance selection changes
findings.recommendedFix: Refresh the header from the appearance selection model

findings.title: The appearance editor is missing from the circuit popup, and layout/appearance tabs have identical titles with a hard-coded tooltip
findings.rootCause: CircuitListView popup has no Edit Appearance entry; EditorTabs uses the same title for both kinds with a literal ' — appearance' tooltip (:255)
findings.recommendedFix: Add popup entries; localised, distinct tab names

findings.title: The default custom appearance has no pin names, and the anchor overlaps the first output port
findings.rootCause: Custom-appearance template adds no text; anchor hit-test wins over ports
findings.recommendedFix: Generate labels; let ports win the hit test

findings.title: Entering a subcircuit needs a double-click within about 7.7px of the magnifier
findings.rootCause: SubcircuitPoker.isWithin uses radius sqrt(60), matching the drawn magnifier
findings.recommendedFix: Accept a double-click anywhere in the instance bounds, or enlarge the target

findings.title: Deleting the main circuit silently promotes the first circuit in the list
findings.rootCause: Main reassignment picks the first circuit and says nothing
findings.recommendedFix: Name the new main in the delete confirmation

findings.title: A multi-bit net is drawn as a thin wire when only one port sets its width
findings.rootCause: WireBundle.setWidth (77-98) sets isBus_ only in the equal-width branch, never on first assignment; also suppresses the bus-width label
findings.recommendedFix: Set isBus_ on first assignment; unit test

findings.title: Only the last error's off-screen arrow is drawn
findings.rootCause: Canvas.computeViewportContents calls setArrows per exception; setArrows starts with clearArrows() (320-324, 649-652)
findings.recommendedFix: Clear the arrows once before the loop

findings.title: The wire inspector shows no width, value or error information
findings.rootCause: Wire attribute set has no width/value rows; no ToolTipMaker
findings.recommendedFix: Read-only Width and Value rows plus a tooltip

findings.title: Clicking a pin digit increments it, and typed digits overwrite from the caret toward the LSB
findings.rootCause: Pin.mouseReleased increments the clicked digit; keyTyped bitCaret -= r with wrap (607-619)
findings.recommendedFix: Place the caret without changing the value; consider a value dialog for every radix

findings.title: Content at negative coordinates is clipped and cannot be reached by scrolling or zoom-to-fit
findings.rootCause: Scrollable area and fit bounds exclude negative coordinates and label extents
findings.recommendedFix: Include negative painted bounds in the scroll area and fit calculation

findings.title: Single-clicking a partly off-canvas label moves it and marks the file dirty
findings.rootCause: Non-negative clamp applied when a zero-distance move is committed
findings.recommendedFix: Create no move action for a click without a drag

findings.title: Dark theme: hard-coded light defaults (Text black, TTY black, I/O labels #0000FF)
findings.rootCause: TextAttributes.java:39 Color.BLACK; Tty.java 155-186 fixed colours; Led:89, DipSwitch:148, PortIo:234, TwoPinLed:107, Button:134, RgbLed:107, MatrixKeypad:209/364, DotMatrixBase:260 use StdAttr.DEFAULT_LABEL_COLOR instead of the theme-aware accessor (StdAttr 51-54)
findings.recommendedFix: Resolve default colours from CanvasStyle tokens at paint time; contrast unit test over Builtin defaults

findings.title: Switching tabs with the Timing panel open shows a blocking clock-source modal while canvas and simulator disagree
findings.rootCause: Model.java 126-136, 403-407 call doClockMultipleObserverDialog when clocks.size() > 1
findings.recommendedFix: Default to the top-level clock; never block a tab switch

findings.title: After an oscillation the status says 'no signals changed' and gives no next step; plural wrong
findings.rootCause: Status bar shows the generic singleStepMessage; the canvas message is separate
findings.recommendedFix: Show 'Stopped: oscillation' with a Reset action; fix the plural

findings.title: Two identical orange pause icons appear while auto-ticking
findings.rootCause: Run/Stop and tick-enable share the pause glyph
findings.recommendedFix: Distinct tick-enable glyph with a pressed state

findings.title: A circuit with a width mismatch is analysed silently as all don't-care
findings.rootCause: Neither Analyze.java nor ProjectCircuitActions checks getWidthIncompatibilityData
findings.recommendedFix: Raise the AnalyzeException and name the net

findings.title: Test-vector panel: failed cells swap between expected and actual after Reset; columns and Show/Set explained only by tooltips
findings.rootCause: One column reused for expected and actual; rows re-sorted; hover-only explanations (TestPanel 176-178)
findings.recommendedFix: Show 'exp->got'; keep file order; visible column labels

findings.title: The analyzer opens tiny, does not scale when maximised, and does not relayout on a UI-scale change
findings.rootCause: Fixed pack size; K-map cells do not scale; no response to UiScale changes
findings.recommendedFix: Size relative to the parent; scale content; grow on scale change

findings.title: The first click on an unselected DIP switch only selects it
findings.rootCause: InstancePokerAdapter.getPokeCaret calls mousePressed (:92) and PokeTool.mousePressed calls it again (256-258); DipSwitch.Poker toggles in mousePressed so the first click toggles twice
findings.recommendedFix: Fix the double dispatch in PokeTool/InstancePokerAdapter

findings.title: The hex editor's own undo does nothing, and its Edit menu is the full circuit menu
findings.rootCause: HexFrame.EditListener.register (199-205) wires only cut/copy/paste/delete/select-all
findings.recommendedFix: Route undo/redo to the project; trim the menu

findings.title: Typing hex digits does not advance to the next byte
findings.rootCause: Caret.keyTyped (267-307) shifts digits in; only Space/Enter/arrows move
findings.recommendedFix: Auto-advance after a full cell; show a hint

findings.title: An oversized memory image is truncated with a self-contradicting message and an unbounded dialog width
findings.rootCause: Warnings not listed in the details box; wrong plural; dialog sized to the longest line
findings.recommendedFix: List the warnings; fix the plural; cap the width

findings.title: The recovery prompt names the file by UUID and forces a Save; the saved file has no .circ extension
findings.rootCause: Startup recovery path bypasses doSaveAs validation and extension logic
findings.recommendedFix: Show time and circuits; offer Restore; reuse doSaveAs

findings.title: Reload Library does not refresh the library tree view
findings.rootCause: No structure-changed event after LibraryManager.reload
findings.recommendedFix: Fire treeStructureChanged after reload

findings.title: Rejected library loads leave undo entries, and one merge takes 11 mislabelled undo steps
findings.rootCause: LoadLibraries (393-450) still builds an Action when every library is rejected; merge is not a compound action
findings.recommendedFix: Skip empty actions; wrap the merge in one action

findings.title: A non-JAR file leads to a bare class-name prompt and a misleading 'class not found'
findings.rootCause: File not validated as a JAR before the prompt
findings.recommendedFix: Validate the JAR; list the Library classes it contains

findings.title: HDL Validate checks only the entity header; broken architecture code passes silently
findings.rootCause: HdlContentView.doValidate (131-136) only parses the ports
findings.recommendedFix: State what was checked; optionally run GHDL

findings.title: The FPGA commander's Toplevel silently follows the current circuit
findings.rootCause: FpgaCommander.projectChanged on ACTION_SET_CURRENT calls setCurrentSheet
findings.recommendedFix: Decouple Toplevel from the current circuit, or make the follow explicit

findings.title: The commander layout does not grow, and errors are cut off
findings.rootCause: Fixed layout weights; no line wrap
findings.recommendedFix: Let the report pane fill the window and wrap text

findings.title: FPGA mapping needs one dialog per bit and has tiny hit targets
findings.rootCause: Partial-map dialog maps one bit at a time
findings.recommendedFix: Bus-to-group mapping; larger targets

findings.title: The language list applies the language on every arrow key and does not preselect the current one
findings.rootCause: LocaleSelector.valueChanged applies via invokeLater on every selection change; exact Locale equality misses preselect
findings.recommendedFix: Apply on Enter/double-click; preselect the active locale

findings.title: Switching language while the settings filter has text strands the user on 'No settings match'
findings.rootCause: SettingsNav re-runs the filter against the new locale's labels
findings.recommendedFix: Clear the filter on locale change

findings.title: New shell strings are untranslated in every locale, and there is a large German backlog
findings.rootCause: explorerTab, explorerFilterHint, propertiesEmptyHint exist only in gui.properties; gui_de 105 and std_de 129 '# ==>' keys; typo gui_de.properties:647 'Internationalierung'
findings.recommendedFix: Run trans-tool for the new keys; fix the typo

findings.title: A pin added from the search palette looks different from the toolbar Pin
findings.rootCause: AddToolSearchProvider reuses the library AddTool; the toolbar holds a separate preconfigured AddTool (pre-existing design)
findings.recommendedFix: Share or sync default attributes between toolbar and library tools

findings.title: Editing a property from the keyboard takes many hidden steps
findings.rootCause: Enter moves to the next row; no focus-inspector shortcut
findings.recommendedFix: Enter or F2 starts editing; add an edit-label shortcut

findings.title: Omni-search matches project names in breadcrumbs, gives junk fuzzy results, and does not index settings or labels
findings.rootCause: Match text includes the breadcrumb; uncapped subsequence gaps; PreferenceSearchProvider indexes page names only
findings.recommendedFix: Exclude the project name; cap fuzzy gaps; index settings and labels

findings.title: The Library Reference hides the Base library and shows a developer test node
findings.rootCause: contents.xml 230-257 comments out Base/TCL/BFH/SOC/HDL; 258-261 shows 'Tests for documentation'
findings.recommendedFix: Un-comment Base; drop the test node

findings.title: The memory image format dialog uses checkboxes for exclusive options

findings.title: Switching theme resets the Preferences scroll position

findings.title: The autosave interval is saved only on Enter

findings.title: The Assembly viewer opens at screen (0,0)

findings.title: The FPGA pre-multiplier accepts 0

findings.title: Preferences International page has large empty space

visualSweepMembers.title: Preferences dialog leaves large unused vertical space, more so at 2.0x

visualSweepMembers.title: Properties panel is empty/unhelpful by default
visualSweepMembers.note: Intentional empty state (Hand tool active); remaining polish idea only. Prior inspector-10 is narrowed: a hint now exists.

findings.title: RAM/ROM IEC dependency labels and pin numbers are about 7px and tightly stacked at 100% zoom
findings.rootCause: Memory painters use small fixed fonts on a 10px pin pitch; hex cells themselves are ~10px near-white on near-black and readable
findings.recommendedFix: Hide the per-bit dependency notation below a zoom threshold or draw it at a legible minimum size; do not remove it (IEC notation)

visualSweepMembers.title: Memory component hex-dump content is very small and low-contrast at 100% zoom
visualSweepMembers.note: Hex cells are high contrast; what is small is the ~7px 'A,1,3' labels and crowded 'M3 [Write enable]'/'M2 [Output enable]' lines.

visualSweepMembers.title: RAM/ROM pin-label text overlaps sibling labels at default zoom
visualSweepMembers.note: No overlap visible; M3/M2/C1 lines are packed on the 10px pitch but do not collide. Legibility nit.

findings.title: Project Options > Toolbar list draws tool icons touching the first letter of their labels
findings.rootCause: The toolbar-list cell renderer sets no icon-text gap
findings.recommendedFix: Use the same icon-text gap as the explorer tree (4-6px scaled)

visualSweepMembers.title: Zero pixel gap between tool icon and label text in the available/current-tools lists
visualSweepMembers.note: Hand, arrow, wire and text icons touch 'Interact', 'Edit', 'Wire', 'Text'.

findings.title: Parts picker drops every component name at 2.0x in a 1280x800 window (icon-only single column)
findings.rootCause: Picker tile/grid width does not reflow for the scale factor in a narrow sidebar; it falls back to unlabelled icons
findings.recommendedFix: Below a width threshold switch to a single labelled list row (icon + full name) instead of dropping captions; scale the minimum sidebar width

visualSweepMembers.title: Component labels vanish from parts picker at 2.0x scale on a 1280x800 window
visualSweepMembers.note: Confirmed in dark and light; 1.0x shows names. 640x400 logical is an extreme case, but names are only reachable by hovering.

findings.title: Properties labels and values truncate even at 1.0x (e.g. 'Data bus implement...')
findings.rootCause: Inspector default width and fixed label/value split elide long attribute names and values
findings.recommendedFix: Wrap labels to two lines or widen the label column; full text in tooltip

visualSweepMembers.title: Long property labels truncate even at 1.0x scale on a 1280-wide window
visualSweepMembers.note: 'Data bus implement...', 'Simulation reset be...', 'Clear contents on re...', 'Separate data buses...'. Panel is resizable.

findings.title: UI type scale is flat: welcome headline, panel headers and body sit within ~11-15px
findings.rootCause: UiFonts roles are close in size; the welcome headline (~15px semibold) is barely larger than its body (~12px)
findings.recommendedFix: Define a 4-step type scale (empty-state headline ~20, panel header 13 semibold, body 12-13, caption 11) in UiFonts

visualSweepMembers.title: No clear type-scale hierarchy between window title, panel headers, and body/canvas labels
visualSweepMembers.note: Welcome headline weak hierarchy confirmed; muted panel captions are an IDE convention and canvas labels are not UI type. Subjective polish.

visualSweep.method: Five visual-QA inspectors (main shell, dialogs, scale matrix, canvas components, design critique) drove the frozen jar in the isolated KWin/Xwayland harness; each report got a skeptical screenshot review. Severity is the reviewer's adjustedSeverity.
refutedClaims: Colors page canvas/grid swatches invisible (they have the same 2px border)
RAM 'A,1,3' labels repeated per row (IEC dependency notation, per bit line)
Ctrl+Shift+A no selection (that is Search; Select All is Ctrl+A)
Secondary grey near AA boundary (own estimate ~6.5:1)
